title: Motion in a Plane - SBA Bucket Map

rows.subtopic_bucket: From one direction to two - 1D vs 2D, coordinates, axes, origin, shared time
What makes a projectile? - projectile, trajectory, launch anatomy, launch angle, range terminology
One clock, two directions - resolve u, horizontal and vertical component equations
Follow velocity through the flight - rising, apex, falling, velocity direction, minimum speed
Same-height flight - time, range, height, complementary angles, maximum range, R/H relations
Describe the path without time - eliminate t, derive y(x), read path geometry, wall-coordinate and vector-notation transfer
Horizontal launch and launch from height - vertical fall clock, impact velocity, displacement geometry, unequal-height signed motion
Projectile meets a sloping plane - plane equation, trajectory intersection, along-plane range, projection geometry and normal-impact constraints
Use one clock at a special event - timed coordinates, recovering launch components, continuing the same flight, time partitions and event height
